title: 2009 L'Aquila earthquake
summary: A magnitude-6.3 earthquake struck near L'Aquila in Abruzzi, central Italy, on 6 April 2009, extensively damaging the 13th-century city. More than 300 people died and an estimated 60,000 were left homeless. The G8 summit was moved to L'Aquila, and later manslaughter convictions of scientists were overturned on appeal.

as_recorded.value: severe earthquake that occurred on April 6, 2009

importance.justification: Italy's worst earthquake in 30 years per Britannica, with over 300 deaths and lasting political and legal consequences.

audience_note: Mentions mass death and displacement from a natural disaster.
